name: What is a structural modification in home remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What is a structural modification in home remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: A structural modification in home remodeling involves altering the primary load-bearing elements of your home, such as walls, beams, or foundations, to change the layout, add space, or improve functionality. This often includes removing walls for an open-concept kitchen, adding new windows or doors, or expanding your home with an addition. AKN Design Group integrates these modifications seamlessly into our comprehensive design-build process, ensuring structural integrity and aesthetic harmony. Understanding the scope of these changes early on helps us develop a precise project plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Structural modification involves altering load-bearing elements of your home to change the layout or add space, often for an open-concept design or an addition.
